entry.name: Orks/FinkinbitzDescription
entry.value: Grants ore when killing an enemy.

entry.name: Orks/FinkinbitzFlavor
entry.value: Strategically affixed to the Ork's back, the Finkinbitz backpack becomes an indispensable tool on the battlefield. As the Ork charges into the fray, the saw-equipped apparatus comes to life guided by its built in grot, churning and grinding with ferocious energy. Its purpose is not only to pulverize and dismantle opponents but also to efficiently collect metallic spoils in the heat of battle. The backpack's rough and unfinished appearance mirrors the Orks' resourceful nature, embodying the essence of their penchant for repurposing technology to suit their brutish needs.
